source.author: cic
source.text: Tota enim philosophorum vita, ut ait idem, commentatio mortis est.
source.text_original: Tota enim philosophorum vita, ut ait idem, commentatio mortis est.
source.text_english: For the entire life of philosophers, as the same man says, is a rehearsal for death.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Platonis sententia est omnem sapienti uitam meditationem esse mortis.
reuse.text_original: Platonis sententia est omnem sapienti uitam meditationem esse mortis.
reuse.text_english: It is Plato’s view that the whole life of the wise man is a meditation on death.
